patterns.safety_requirement: warn on unsaved filters and never carry a key across workspaces
no silent mode change; Enforce requires explicit Human authorization and confirmation
machine reason codes remain exportable and filters are URL/state reproducible
high-impact authorization and deletion use a full page, not a transient drawer
timestamp includes timezone and missing steps remain visible
scope, expiry, policy revision and supersession are visible before decision

patterns.titmas_use: upload/reference then local or server verification
patterns.safety_requirement: PASS never renders as truth, legality, safety or certification
export declares content classes, digest, signature profile and missing evidence
one-time display, masked later, exact scopes, TTL and revocation
confirmation, retained exception disclosure, execution record and verification status
does not claim healthy when no evidence exists
stable reason code, remediation hint and correlation ID without secrets
